description: Backend core: extend config, add Supabase auth dependency, update db engine, add SQLAlchemy models (Profile, Conversation, Message, LearningResource, PracticeSession), update schemas to remove client-supplied correct_answer, create GroqService replacing raw httpx LLM calls, update questions.py to store answers server-side and never return correct_answer in generate response, update main.py with all new routes (health/ready, subjects, learning-resources, chat), auth-protect existing routes, remove demo seed from startup, update .env.example files.
steps: 1. EXTEND backend/app/core/config.py — add these fields to Settings class: app_env: str = 'development', api_prefix: str = '/api', frontend_origin: str = 'http://localhost:5173', supabase_url: str = '', supabase_publishable_key: str = '', supabase_service_role_key: str = '', database_url stays but now defaults to 'sqlite:///./learnwise.db', groq_api_key: str = '', groq_model: str = '', groq_base_url: str = 'https://api.groq.com/openai/v1', llm_timeout_seconds: int = 45, max_questions_per_request: int = 10, max_csv_size_mb: int = 10. Keep existing llm_api_key/llm_base_url/llm_model for backward compat. Add @model_validator(mode='after') that raises ValueError if groq_api_key is non-empty but groq_model is empty. Update origins property to use frontend_origin instead of cors_origins field (keep cors_origins field for backward compat too, merging both). Add is_demo_mode property: returns True when supabase_url is empty string.

2. PIN NEW BACKEND DEPENDENCIES in backend/requirements.txt — add these lines (keep all existing): supabase>=2.9.0,<3.0  |  groq>=0.9.0,<1.0  |  python-jose[cryptography]>=3.3.0,<4.0  |  pytest-asyncio>=0.23.0,<1.0  |  anyio[trio]>=4.0,<5.0. Important: supabase SDK 2.x uses supabase.create_client(url, key), NOT supabase.Client(). groq SDK 0.9+ uses groq.Groq(api_key=...) with client.chat.completions.create(). python-jose is used only for optional JWT decode fallback; primary auth is supabase.auth.get_user(token).

3. CREATE backend/app/auth.py — FastAPI dependency get_current_user(authorization: str = Header(None)) -> str. Logic: (a) if settings.is_demo_mode: return 'demo-user-001' with no token check. (b) if authorization is None or not authorization.startswith('Bearer '): raise HTTPException(401, detail='Missing or invalid Authorization header'). (c) token = authorization.split(' ', 1)[1]. (d) try: response = supabase_client.auth.get_user(token); user_id = response.user.id; return user_id. (e) except any exception: raise HTTPException(401, detail='Token invalid or expired'). Import supabase_client from app.db (will be defined in step 4). Expose also optional_user dependency: same logic but returns None instead of raising when no token (used for CSV import which is optionally auth-protected).

4. UPDATE backend/app/db.py — keep existing SQLAlchemy engine/session code. Add Supabase client init: import create_client from supabase. Add module-level supabase_client variable: if settings.supabase_url: supabase_client = create_client(settings.supabase_url, settings.supabase_publishable_key) else: supabase_client = None. The engine creation logic already handles sqlite vs postgres via connect_args check — keep that. No change needed to get_db().

5. UPDATE backend/app/models.py — add four new SQLAlchemy models. Keep AssessmentRecord and PracticeAttempt exactly as-is (do not remove student_id or existing columns; we add user_id alongside). Add nullable user_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(80), index=True, nullable=True) to BOTH AssessmentRecord and PracticeAttempt. New models: (a) Profile — __tablename__='profiles', id: Mapped[str]=mapped_column(String(80), primary_key=True) [stores user UUID], display_name: Mapped[str | None]=mapped_column(String(200), nullable=True), education_level: Mapped[str | None]=mapped_column(String(80), nullable=True), created_at: Mapped[datetime]=mapped_column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow), updated_at: Mapped[datetime]=mapped_column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow). (b) Conversation — __tablename__='conversations', id: Mapped[str]=mapped_column(String(80), primary_key=True, default=lambda:str(uuid4())), user_id: Mapped[str]=mapped_column(String(80), index=True), title: Mapped[str]=mapped_column(String(300), default='New conversation'), created_at/updated_at as DateTime. (c) Message — __tablename__='messages', id: Mapped[str]=mapped_column(String(80), primary_key=True, default=lambda:str(uuid4())), conversation_id: Mapped[str]=mapped_column(String(80), index=True), role: Mapped[str]=mapped_column(String(20)) [system/user/assistant], content: Mapped[str]=mapped_column(Text), created_at. (d) LearningResource — __tablename__='learning_resources', id: Mapped[int]=mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True), title: Mapped[str]=mapped_column(String(300)), description: Mapped[str | None]=mapped_column(Text, nullable=True), subject: Mapped[str]=mapped_column(String(100), index=True), topic: Mapped[str | None]=mapped_column(String(160), nullable=True), resource_type: Mapped[str]=mapped_column(String(50), default='article'), url: Mapped[str | None]=mapped_column(Text, nullable=True), source_note: Mapped[str | None]=mapped_column(String(100), nullable=True), created_at. (e) PracticeSession — __tablename__='practice_sessions', id: Mapped[str]=mapped_column(String(80), primary_key=True, default=lambda:str(uuid4())), user_id: Mapped[str]=mapped_column(String(80), index=True), subject: Mapped[str]=mapped_column(String(100)), topic: Mapped[str]=mapped_column(String(160)), difficulty: Mapped[str]=mapped_column(String(20), default='medium'), questions_json: Mapped[str]=mapped_column(Text) [JSON string of full question list including correct_answer, stored server-side only], status: Mapped[str]=mapped_column(String(20), default='active'), created_at. Import uuid4 from uuid at top of file.

6. UPDATE backend/app/schemas.py — remove student_id and correct_answer from all request schemas. New schemas: (a) PracticeGenerateRequest: subject, topic (Field min_length=2, max_length=160), difficulty='medium', count: int=Field(default=5,ge=1,le=10), exam_track='Class 11-12'. Remove student_id field. (b) PracticeSubmitAnswer: question_id: str, selected_answer: str [no correct_answer, no question text, no topic — server looks up from session]. (c) PracticeSubmitRequest: session_id: str, answers: list[PracticeSubmitAnswer]. Remove student_id. (d) ConversationCreate: title: str = 'New conversation'. (e) MessageCreate: content: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=4000). (f) ChatMessageResponse: id, conversation_id, role, content, created_at. (g) LearningResourceResponse: id, title, description, subject, topic, resource_type, url. (h) SubjectResponse: name: str. (i) HealthReadyResponse: status: str, database: str, llm: str. Keep AnswerSubmission for CSV import backward compat if needed, or remove — it is not used by any route after this change.

7. CREATE backend/app/services/groq_service.py — GroqService class with __init__(self) that reads settings. Methods: (a) async generate_questions(topic, subject, difficulty, count, exam_track) -> tuple[list[dict], str]: if neither groq_api_key nor llm_api_key is set: return demo_questions(topic,count,difficulty),'demo'. If groq_api_key set: use groq SDK (groq.AsyncGroq(api_key=settings.groq_api_key)), model=settings.groq_model. Else fall back to httpx against settings.llm_base_url with settings.llm_api_key. Build system prompt: 'You create careful educational assessments. Return valid JSON only.' Build user prompt requesting count MCQs for exam_track/subject/topic/difficulty, JSON format {questions:[{question,options:[4 strings],correct_answer,solution,difficulty,concept}]}. CRITICAL: strip correct_answer before returning to caller — questions going back to the API response must NOT include correct_answer. Return (questions_without_correct_answer, provider_str). Store full questions (with correct_answer) separately for session storage. Method signature: async generate_questions(...) -> tuple[list[dict], list[dict], str] where first list is safe (no correct_answer), second list is full (with correct_answer for storage). Handle: 429 -> retry once after 2s, else fall back to demo. Timeout (settings.llm_timeout_seconds). 401 -> log warning, fall back to demo. JSON parse error -> fall back to demo. Never log groq_api_key. (b) async chat_response(messages: list[dict]) -> str: sends messages to Groq/LLM, returns assistant reply string. System prompt: 'You are LearnWise AI, a helpful study mentor for Class 11-12 students. Provide clear, curriculum-aligned explanations.' If no key configured, return a helpful demo response string. Handle errors gracefully. (c) groq_service = GroqService() singleton at module level.

8. UPDATE backend/app/services/questions.py — replace generate_questions function to use groq_service. New signature: async generate_questions(topic, subject, difficulty, count, exam_track) -> tuple[list[dict], list[dict], str] returning (safe_questions, full_questions, provider). Import GroqService from groq_service, use module-level groq_service instance. Keep demo_questions() and BANK unchanged. Add DEMO_QUESTIONS_FULL that mirrors BANK but is used internally for storage. Make demo_questions_full(topic, count, difficulty) return full questions with correct_answer for storage. Update demo_questions() to strip correct_answer from returned items (it currently DOES return correct_answer — fix this now). The safe demo questions must not have correct_answer key.

9. UPDATE backend/app/main.py — comprehensive rewrite keeping all existing route paths. Key changes: (a) Remove seed_demo() and @app.on_event('startup') entirely. (b) Add startup event that only calls Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine). (c) Import get_current_user, optional_user from app.auth. Import Conversation, Message, LearningResource, PracticeSession from app.models. Import all new schemas. Import groq_service from app.services.groq_service. (d) ADD GET /api/health/ready -> check DB connection (try db.execute(text('SELECT 1'))), check if LLM key configured. (e) ADD GET /api/subjects -> return hardcoded list of 5 subjects or query LearningResource.subject distinct values. (f) ADD GET /api/learning-resources?subject=&topic= -> query LearningResource table, filter by subject/topic if provided, return list. (g) Auth-protect these routes by adding current_user: str = Depends(get_current_user): GET /api/dashboard, GET /api/topics, GET /api/recommendations, POST /api/practice/generate, POST /api/practice/submit, GET /api/reports/{student_id}, GET/POST /api/chat/conversations, POST /api/chat/conversations/{id}/messages. (h) Update /api/dashboard, /api/topics, /api/recommendations to use current_user as the student_id instead of query param default 'STU001'. Keep query param for backward compat in demo mode. (i) Update /api/practice/generate: call generate_questions from groq_service via questions.py, create PracticeSession(user_id=current_user, subject=..., topic=..., difficulty=..., questions_json=json.dumps(full_questions)), save to db, return {session_id, topic, subject, provider, questions: safe_questions, notice}. (j) Update /api/practice/submit: payload now has session_id + answers list with only question_id+selected_answer. Load PracticeSession from db by session_id. Verify session.user_id == current_user (403 if mismatch). Parse session.questions_json to get full questions. For each answer, find matching question by id, compare selected_answer to stored correct_answer. Save PracticeAttempt with user_id=current_user. (k) Update /api/reports/{student_id}: if current_user != student_id and not demo mode, raise HTTPException(403). (l) ADD GET /api/chat/conversations: query Conversation where user_id==current_user, return list. (m) ADD POST /api/chat/conversations: create Conversation(user_id=current_user, title=payload.title or 'New conversation'), return it. (n) ADD POST /api/chat/conversations/{conv_id}/messages: verify conversation.user_id==current_user (404 if not found, 403 if mismatch). Save user Message. Load recent messages (last 20) for context. Call groq_service.chat_response(messages). Save assistant Message. Return assistant ChatMessageResponse. (o) /api/import/csv: change to optional_user, if user authenticated save user_id on records. (p) Keep CORS middleware using settings.origins. Keep /api/health public.
acceptance_criteria: cd backend && pytest passes all existing tests (test_weak_topic_ranked_first must still pass)
cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 starts without errors when no .env is configured (demo mode with SQLite)
GET /api/health/ready returns {status: ok, database: ok, llm: configured|not_configured}
POST /api/practice/generate with no auth returns 401 when SUPABASE_URL is set; returns questions (no correct_answer key in any question) when in demo mode
POST /api/practice/submit uses session_id to look up stored correct answers server-side — no correct_answer in request body
GET /api/subjects returns list with Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, Computer Science
Auth dependency returns demo-user-001 when SUPABASE_URL is not configured
No groq_api_key value appears in any log output
verification: cd backend && python -c "from app.core.config import settings; print(settings.is_demo_mode)" (should print True with no .env)
findings: COMPLETED. psycopg[binary]>=3.1,<4.0 was added to requirements.txt (needed because .env has a Postgres DATABASE_URL — without it, `import app.db` raises ModuleNotFoundError during test collection). All 9 implementation steps done. pytest passes (1 test). Key facts for later FEATs: (1) PracticeSession.questions_json holds full questions with correct_answer — never expose this field in API responses. (2) Auth dependency is in app/auth.py; get_current_user raises 401 in production, returns 'demo-user-001' in demo mode. (3) GroqService singleton is groq_service in app/services/groq_service.py. (4) settings.is_demo_mode == True when SUPABASE_URL is empty. (5) All 5 new SQLAlchemy models (Profile, Conversation, Message, LearningResource, PracticeSession) added to app/models.py alongside existing AssessmentRecord and PracticeAttempt (user_id column added as nullable to both). (6) No seed data on startup — Base.metadata.create_all only.
